svg.title: Chemist — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as chemist, wearing a protective coat and protective goggles. Visible work cue: A conical flask has a narrow neck and a clear liquid line beside a separate long stirring rod. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: protective goggles.
